newsitem.title: SPAIN: American best offer for Argentine airline -Iberia.
newsitem.headline: American best offer for Argentine airline -Iberia.

text.p: The chairman of Spanish state-owned airline Iberia, Xabier de Irala, said on Monday American Airlines presented the best offer for the Argentine company Aerolinas Argentinas.

In a interview published today by the Spanish financial daily Cinco Dias he said "..many candidates have made offers and in the end only two remained, American and Continental. Although the deal is not yet signed, the best offer is the one from American".

Earlier this year Aerolineas' main shareholders invited bids from AMR Crop unit American Airlines and Continental Airlines to buy a stake in the privatised South American carrier operated by Spain's Iberia.
A 63.35 percent stake in Aerolinas Argentinas is controlled by a group formed by Spanish State holding SEPI, Merrill Lynch and Bankers Trust.
